availability: Class B: GDELT batch time + 15 minutes
exclusions: an origin is scored only if its feed window is complete, scoring coverage is at least 98%, market inputs through t-1 exist, news warm-up is complete, and a label exists

fitting.linear: QuantileRegressor(highs), median impute, constant filter, StandardScaler
fitting.refit: first origin of each calendar month, expanding window
fitting.training_rows: eligible rows whose label was available by the refit cutoff

information_cutoff: 30 minutes before the scheduled XNYS close; market inputs through t-1
no_redesign: No feature, setting, split or method is changed after the test is opened.

primary_comparison.metric: mean pinball-loss difference on common eligible target sessions
primary_comparison.supported_if: mean improvement > 0 and the block-20 interval excludes zero
primary_comparison.uncertainty: paired moving-block bootstrap, 2,000 replications, block 20, seed 1729, 95% percentile interval; blocks 10 and 5 as robustness

secondary_exploratory: Q2 vs Q0, Q1 vs Q0, Q0 and Q2 vs the development-selected strongest baseline
tree challenger T0/T1/T2 with development-selected settings
rebuild-and-refit sensitivities: buffer 60/240 minutes, one-session delay, sentiment lag 5/20, recap exclusion, dominant-source exclusion, raw counts
ex-ante volatility regimes from training-period terciles of vol_21
target: S&P 500 price-index next-session close-to-close simple return
